He looks around, appearing confused or stressed, touching his stomach area while looking at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the man holding a pink smartphone; his expression shifts to a wide smile as he taps the screen. The background is a plain white wall with natural light. (3) He is seen holding a green paper bag with 'Uber Eats' branding and using a spoon to eat from a container inside. He looks satisfied and relaxed. (4) Back at the open suitcase, he looks at his phone again. A hand from off-screen passes him another green bag. He pulls out a yellow toothbrush package and holds it up. (5) A fast-forward sequence shows the man moving rapidly around the room, which contains a white chair, a lamp, and an air purifier. The suitcase remains open on the floor as he throws items inside. (6) The man wipes sweat from his forehead, looking exhausted and thirsty. He pulls at the neck of his blue shirt. He reaches for his phone again, looking determined. (7) He is seen peering from a doorway, wearing a white tank top and a towel over his shoulder. A second man in a white t-shirt appears at a front door, receiving a green bag from an unseen delivery person. (8) The second man sits in a kitchen area with a white cup, looking intently at his phone, while the first man leans on his shoulder. (9) The first man sits on the floor with a large green bag. He pulls out a red packet, a white electronic device, a black snack bag, a clear toiletry bag, and a large blue board game box. (10) Both men sit together by the suitcase. The suitcase is now full of the travel items. They talk to each other; the second man holds a cup. They have a playful scuffle over the drink. (11) The two men stand side-by-side, holding a green Uber Eats bag and smiling directly at the camera for the outro.
